cast_scope: same residual after decoder l, equivalent to input of decoder l+1; all prefill positions plus decode; condition read before modification and reused

selection: validation Macro utility descending, then H descending, lower layer, lower alpha, lexical method

confidence: five fact-grouped validation temperature fits over [.25,.5,1,2,4,8]; no blind fit

quality_stopping: greedy EOS or token cap, matching old PopQA outputs
top10_capture: raw first context-forward LM-head logits and vocabulary IDs from existing forward, not probe logits
blind_access: read blind inputs for inference only after source configuration and temperatures freeze
inference_scope: supplementary baselines on already unblinded PopQA cohorts; not a new prospective confirmation
